name: SIANO Vision AltText AI
author: sianomadgroup

sections.description:
SIANO Vision AltText AI uses advanced AI vision models (GPT-4o, Groq) to automatically generate SEO-optimized alt-text for your WordPress images. Unlike basic OCR plugins that simply read text in images, SIANO Vision AltText AI understands image context, composition, and subject matter to create descriptive, keyword-rich alt-text that improves both search rankings and accessibility compliance.

Why SIANO Vision AltText AI is Different

🤖 AI Vision Models, Not OCR

Most alt-text plugins use basic optical character recognition (OCR) or simple templates. SIANO Vision AltText AI uses state-of-the-art vision AI that actually “sees” and understands your images like a human would.

🎯 SEO-Optimized by Design

Our advanced multi-factor prompting system considers:

  • Image composition and subject matter
  • Filename context and keywords
  • Technical image details
  • Accessibility best practices
  • Character length optimization (115–125 chars target)

🔒 Enterprise-Grade Security

API keys are encrypted at rest using AES-256-CBC encryption, meeting enterprise security standards.

Example Transformations

Before (Manual): image_1234.jpg
After (SIANO Vision AltText AI): Professional woman in blue blazer presenting data analytics dashboard on laptop screen in modern office environment

Before (Basic OCR): Sale 50% Off
After (SIANO Vision AltText AI): Red promotional banner advertising 50% off summer sale with shopping cart icon and bright yellow call-to-action button

Before (Generic): Product photo
After (SIANO Vision AltText AI): Minimalist ceramic coffee mug with matte black finish on white marble countertop with soft natural lighting

Features

  • ✅ AI-powered alt-text generation using GPT-4o or Groq
  • ✅ Bulk processing — process your entire media library with one click
  • ✅ Support for multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Groq)
  • ✅ Single-image regeneration directly from Media Library
  • ✅ Encrypted API key storage (AES-256-CBC)
  • ✅ Real-time processing logs and monitoring
  • ✅ Smart filename context detection
  • ✅ Media library error overlay for failed images
  • ✅ Clean, modern admin dashboard

Want More? Go Pro

SIANO Vision AltText AI Pro is a premium addon that requires an active subscription to unlock:

  • 🚀 Priority Processing — Bulk images process 4× faster
  • ✏️ Custom Prompt Templates — Tailor the AI prompt to your brand
  • 📊 Alt-Text Quality Scoring — Automated 100-point quality assessment
  • 🔄 Alt-Text History — Stores up to 10 previous versions with one-click revert
  • 📥 CSV Export & Import — Bulk manage alt-text via spreadsheets
  • ⚡ Auto-Generate on Upload — Every new image gets alt-text automatically
  • 🎯 Selective Bulk Re-Process — Filter by missing, low-quality, or all

Perfect For

  • E-commerce Stores — Improve product image SEO and conversions
  • Photography Portfolios — Showcase your work with rich, professional descriptions
  • News & Magazine Sites — Handle high-volume image publishing efficiently
  • Accessibility-Focused Organizations — Meet WCAG 2.1 compliance standards
  • Digital Agencies — Automate client website optimization at scale
  • Bloggers & Content Creators — Save hours on manual alt-text writing

AI Provider Notice:

This plugin connects to third-party AI services (OpenAI, Groq) to generate alt-text. Your images are sent to these external services for processing. Please review their privacy policies:

  • OpenAI Privacy Policy
  • Groq Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the siano-vision-alttext-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to SIANO Vision AltText AI in your admin menu
  4. Enter your AI provider API key in the Settings tab
  5. Start generating alt-text for your images
sections.faq:
Which AI providers are supported?

Currently OpenAI (GPT-4o models) and Groq are supported. You’ll need an API key from one of these providers to use the plugin.

Is bulk processing available?

Yes! Bulk processing is included FREE for all users. Process your entire media library with one click from the Dashboard tab.

Can I regenerate alt-text for a single image?

Yes. Open any image in your Media Library and click the “Regenerate Alt Text” button to get fresh AI-generated alt-text.

How is this different from other alt-text plugins?

Most plugins use basic OCR (text recognition) or generic templates. SIANO Vision AltText AI uses advanced vision AI models that actually understand image content, context, and composition — similar to how a human describes images.

Is my API key secure?

Yes. All API keys are encrypted at rest using military-grade AES-256-CBC encryption before being stored in your database.
